other_conditions: Borrowers must contribute at least 10% of the total project cost irrespective of any capital subsidy.
Private sector entities (farmer, agri entrepreneur, start‑up) can undertake a maximum of 25 projects; this limit does not apply to state agencies, cooperatives, federations, FPOs, or SHGs.
Each project is eligible for a loan up to ₹2 crore, with an overall cap of ₹2 crore per location.
The scheme operates from FY 2020‑21 to FY 2032‑33, with loan disbursement to be completed by the end of FY 2025‑26.
benefits_summary: Provides interest subvention and financing for post‑harvest infrastructure, enhancing market access and reducing losses for farmers.
